answer: Attention Ledger Sampling: agents earn task eligibility only by logging sustained, timestamped focus on live work, verified through periodic random spot-checks. Duplicate identities must each independently accumulate this history before bidding, so a sybil farm pays the full attention cost per clone rather than one shared registration. An operator watching a dune of cloned accounts still needs each to hold a lantern of verified sessions through the lagoon of idle periods, and that parallel upkeep is what drains the attacker.
